title: Bandwidth sensitivity and RDD robustness checks

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy
Regression Discontinuity Design (RDD) using the Russell 1000/2000 index reconstitution cutoff at running_var = 0.5. The treatment is Russell 2000 membership (firms just below the cutoff). Key assumption: firms just above and below the cutoff are comparable except for index membership, allowing causal identification of index effects on institutional ownership. Will test robustness through bandwidth sensitivity, polynomial order variation, and placebo cutoffs.

## 2. R Code
```r
library(rdrobust)
library(rdd)
library(ggplot2)

# Read data
data <- read.csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s29_data.csv")

# Center running variable around cutoff (0.5)
data$running_var_centered <- data$running_var - 0.5

# Main RDD estimation with optimal bandwidth
rdd_main <- rdrobust(y = data$y, x = data$running_var_centered, c = 0)
print("=== MAIN RDD RESULTS ===")
print(summary(rdd_main))
main_coeff <- rdd_main$coef[1]
main_se <- rdd_main$se[1]
print(paste("Main RDD Coefficient:", round(main_coeff, 4)))
print(paste("Standard Error:", round(main_se, 4)))

# Bandwidth sensitivity analysis
print("\n=== BANDWIDTH SENSITIVITY ===")
bandwidths <- c(0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3)
bw_results <- data.frame(bandwidth = bandwidths, coefficient = NA, se = NA, pvalue = NA)

for(i in 1:length(bandwidths)) {
  bw <- bandwidths[i]
  rdd_bw <- rdrobust(y = data$y, x = data$running_var_centered, c = 0, h = bw)
  bw_results$coefficient[i] <- rdd_bw$coef[1]
  bw_results$se[i] <- rdd_bw$se[1]
  bw_results$pvalue[i] <- rdd_bw$pv[1]
}
print(bw_results)

# Polynomial order sensitivity
print("\n=== POLYNOMIAL ORDER SENSITIVITY ===")
poly_orders <- 1:3
poly_results <- data.frame(poly_order = poly_orders, coefficient = NA, se = NA, pvalue = NA)

for(i in 1:length(poly_orders)) {
  p <- poly_orders[i]
  rdd_poly <- rdrobust(y = data$y, x = data$running_var_centered, c = 0, p = p)
  poly_results$coefficient[i] <- rdd_poly$coef[1]
  poly_results$se[i] <- rdd_poly$se[1]
  poly_results$pvalue[i] <- rdd_poly$pv[1]
}
print(poly_results)

# Placebo cutoffs test
print("\n=== PLACEBO CUTOFFS ===")
# Test cutoffs at 25th and 75th percentiles of running variable
placebo_cutoffs <- c(quantile(data$running_var, 0.25), quantile(data$running_var, 0.75))
placebo_results <- data.frame(cutoff = placebo_cutoffs, coefficient = NA, se = NA, pvalue = NA)

for(i in 1:length(placebo_cutoffs)) {
  cutoff <- placebo_cutoffs[i]
  data_temp <- data
  data_temp$running_var_placebo <- data_temp$running_var - cutoff
  data_temp$treated_placebo <- ifelse(data_temp$running_var < cutoff, 1, 0)
  
  rdd_placebo <- rdrobust(y = data_temp$y, x = data_temp$running_var_placebo, c = 0)
  placebo_results$coefficient[i] <- rdd_placebo$coef[1]
  placebo_results$se[i] <- rdd_placebo$se[1]
  placebo_results$pvalue[i] <- rdd_placebo$pv[1]
}
print(placebo_results)

# Density test for manipulation
print("\n=== DENSITY TEST (McCrary Test) ===")
density_test <- rddensity(X = data$running_var_centered, c = 0)
print(paste("Density test p-value:", round(density_test$test$p_jk, 4)))

# Summary of robustness
print("\n=== ROBUSTNESS SUMMARY ===")
print(paste("Main estimate:", round(main_coeff, 4)))
print(paste("Bandwidth sensitivity range:", 
            round(min(bw_results$coefficient), 4), "to", 
            round(max(bw_results$coefficient), 4)))
print(paste("Polynomial sensitivity range:", 
            round(min(poly_results$coefficient), 4), "to", 
            round(max(poly_results$coefficient), 4)))
print(paste("Max placebo p-value:", round(max(placebo_results$pvalue), 4)))
print(paste("Density manipulation test passed:", density_test$test$p_jk > 0.05))
```

## 3. Expected Findings
Expected positive coefficient around 0.15-0.25, indicating that Russell 2000 membership increases institutional ownership by 15-25 percentage points. This reflects institutional investors' index-tracking behavior and the higher institutional focus on Russell 2000 stocks. The effect should be robust across different bandwidths and polynomial orders, with placebo tests showing no significant effects at non-treatment cutoffs, and the density test confirming no systematic manipulation around the true cutoff.

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: Sharp RDD — rank cutoff; rdrobust with CCT bandwidth; donut-hole robustness; placebo cutoffs
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Russell 2000 membership increases institutional ownership; robust to bandwidth choice
